title: Firefly Learning Context v1
description: One-shot handoff note written by Firefly at every launch: who this is, which course, what to do. It is NOT a learning database. Opaque binding IDs (curriculum_id/pipeline_id) may be echoed verbatim from course_binding.json; nothing else about learning state may appear. Enforced by Firefly validators and tests/test_learning_bridge_memory_guard.py.

manifest_path.description: Absolute path to manifest.json. Regenerated by Firefly on every launch; consumers must re-read it, never cache it.

task_id.description: OPTIONAL Firefly-generated reference for THIS run (echoed by the skill into result.json). A run reference, not learning state.

curriculum_id.description: OPTIONAL opaque binding ID returned by teach-mcp. Echo only; never invent.

pipeline_id.description: OPTIONAL opaque binding ID returned by teach-mcp. Echo only; never invent.
